hero.title: VicastCam Global Agency Partnership Program
hero.description: A professional virtual camera live streaming tool, open to global channel partners. Unified USD settlement, regional exclusivity, and full-funnel marketing support.

advantages.description: Easy to sell, low risk, and high margins—VicastCam delivers on all three.

items.title: Massive Creator Market
items.description: Covering live streaming, e-commerce, short video, and content creation, global creator demand is growing steadily, offering a large market and stable conversions.

items.title: Zero Inventory, Online Delivery
items.description: Pure software licensing with instant cloud delivery of activation codes. No stock, no logistics, low cost, supporting batch delivery and quick activation.

items.title: Full-Featured Competitive Edge
items.description: Green screen matting, virtual backgrounds, multi-platform streaming, and AI effects all in one. Complete features that are easy to demonstrate, sell, and renew.

rules.description: Transparent, fair, and predictable agency policies for every partner's peace of mind.

agentLevels.title: Standard Agent
agentLevels.description: An initial order of $30,000 USD grants long-term distribution rights, tiered discounts, and standard channel support.

agentLevels.title: Regional Exclusive Agent
agentLevels.description: Meet quarterly purchase targets to earn exclusive distribution rights for a single region, with no other channels authorized in that area.

settlementRules: Unified USD settlement, supporting payments via HSBC Hong Kong corporate accounts
Batch activation codes delivered instantly via cloud for fast customer delivery
Long-term partners enjoy tiered pricing; higher purchase volumes reduce unit costs

support.description: From materials and technical support to brand authorization and early access to new features, we provide full-funnel support.

items.title: Complete Marketing Materials
items.description: Access website banners, short videos, Reddit/Facebook ad copy, and product review materials instantly.

items.title: Dedicated English Technical Support
items.description: Overseas technical specialists for SDK debugging, live streaming feature after-sales, and customer issue resolution.

items.title: Official Brand Authorization
items.description: Use the VicastCam trademark and product images for regional online and offline promotion.

items.title: Priority Beta Access
items.description: Agents get early access to test and sell all AI effects, streaming updates, and new features.

plans.description: Whether you are a channel, technology vendor, or enterprise service provider, we have a model that fits.

items.title: Channel Agency (Recommended)
items.description: For cross-border software stores, live streaming equipment shops, overseas MCNs, and cross-border e-commerce teams to distribute software licenses at scale.

items.title: OEM White-Label SDK
items.description: Remove all VicastCam branding, customize the logo, software name, and UI, and sell under your own brand.

items.title: Enterprise Customization
items.description: For live streaming service providers, educational institutions, and government/enterprise meeting projects, with custom features and private deployment options.
